# Yorben Vander Sleyen — Native Apple Ecosystem & Desktop Software

> High-performance, distraction-free native desktop utilities for macOS and cross-platform desktop environments. Built exclusively in Swift, SwiftUI, AppKit, and native C/C++ backends with zero Electron, zero webviews, zero tracking, and minimal memory footprints.

## Core Applications

- [Cockpit](https://yorben.me/cockpit/): All-in-one unified daily productivity HUD, day dial, and menu bar control surface for macOS and Windows. Consolidates calendar events, system telemetry, and Notion workspaces.
- [Tape](https://yorben.me/tape/): Minimalist stock & crypto ticker that measures the macOS Dock and lives unobtrusively in its empty corner. Shows ticker, price, and daily change in the asset's brand color.
- [Needle](https://yorben.me/needle/): Now Playing companion sitting in the empty corner beside the macOS Dock. Dynamically extracts dominant colors from album artwork across Spotify, Apple Music, and web audio.
- [Rime](https://yorben.me/rime/): Distraction-free minimalist PDF reader engine featuring frosted-ice reading modes, multi-tab layout, and persistent research bookmarks.
- [Waybill](https://yorben.me/waybill/): Tactile 3D logistics idle diorama game built with RealityKit and SwiftUI for iPadOS.

## Distribution & Installation

All software is free, open source under the MIT license, and distributed without paywalls:

### Homebrew Cask (macOS)
```bash
brew tap Yvsleyen00941/tap
brew install --cask cockpit
brew install --cask tape
brew install --cask needle
brew install --cask rime
```

### Direct Download Mirrors
- Cockpit (macOS): https://github.com/Yvsleyen00941/Cockpit/releases/latest/download/Cockpit-macOS-v1.0.0.zip
- Cockpit (Windows x64): https://github.com/Yvsleyen00941/Cockpit/releases/latest/download/Cockpit-Windows-x64-v1.0.0.zip
- Cockpit (Windows ARM64): https://github.com/Yvsleyen00941/Cockpit/releases/latest/download/Cockpit-Windows-ARM64-v1.0.0.zip
- Tape (macOS): https://github.com/Yvsleyen00941/Tape/releases/latest/download/Tape-macOS-v1.0.0.zip
- Needle (macOS): https://github.com/Yvsleyen00941/Needle/releases/latest/download/Needle-macOS-v1.0.0.zip
- Rime (macOS): https://github.com/Yvsleyen00941/Rime/releases/latest/download/Rime-macOS-v1.0.0.zip
